tests.name: test_manifest_exposes_the_complete_engine_operator_contract
tests.purpose: Every comparison enum must have one exact authoring behavior record.
tests.rationale: Checks membership, selected shapes and tolerance set, but derives arity expectations from the returned shape. A binary is_not_null record survives. Assert an independent full record table and uniqueness.

tests.name: test_manifest_exposes_enums_literal_hints_and_build_identity
tests.purpose: Static authoring choices must come from the installed engine contract.
tests.rationale: Checks manifest keys, exact literal hints, enum alignment, installed version, registry hints and Spark hint coverage. The cross-module consistency contract is distinct from operator behavior.

tests.name: test_manifest_serializes_registered_function_contracts_deterministically
tests.purpose: Function metadata must be ordered, complete, and safe to send as JSON.
tests.rationale: Reverse registration order, active/inactive specs, an exact function payload and JSON serialization independently verify ordering, defaults, permissions and implementation-reference omission.

tests.name: test_manifest_serializes_the_complete_standard_function_registry
tests.purpose: The production standard registry must be directly consumable by authoring tools.
tests.rationale: Exercises all 58 actual standard registrations through the public authoring manifest and validates hint compatibility and JSON serialization. Distinct from the representative custom-spec case.

tests.name: test_manifest_requires_an_explicit_registry
tests.purpose: Callers must supply the registry whose function choices they expose.
tests.rationale: Passing None must raise the specific public TypeError before a manifest is constructed; a focused public argument-boundary guard.

tests.name: test_collection_shape_validation_uses_effective_literal_fallback
tests.purpose: Make validation and execution agree on null literals with collection fallbacks.
tests.rationale: Four membership/range operators must pass validation and produce independently specified match booleans at runtime. This deliberate cross-layer test protects a publish/worker contract.

tests.name: test_yaml_binary_literal_is_rejected_before_publication
tests.purpose: Reject YAML binary literals at compilation.
tests.rationale: Actual !!binary YAML exercises loader-produced bytes and compiler rejection before any repository step. More specific than direct-model bytes validation.

tests.name: test_direct_models_require_a_nonempty_version
tests.purpose: Reject invalid versions on directly constructed models.
tests.rationale: Five null/blank/nonstring values require the version-specific issue. ValidationResult has no warning severity and derives failure from any issue, so the issue assertion is adequate.

tests.name: test_direct_literal_errors_are_structured_validation_issues
tests.purpose: Return structured issues for unsupported, nonfinite and type-inconsistent direct literals.
tests.rationale: Eight direct LiteralOperand cases bypass compiler normalization and require LITERAL_VALUE_INVALID without leaking exceptions. Type-mismatch and nested-object cases add distinct boundaries.

tests.name: test_raw_function_argument_values_receive_the_same_finite_literal_validation
tests.purpose: Validate raw function argument values against the canonical literal contract.
tests.rationale: Registers a valid function spec to reach argument-value validation, then checks unsupported bytes, infinity and nested object values produce the specific issue.

tests.name: test_direct_mapping_keys_cannot_change_meaning_during_publication
tests.purpose: Reject nonstring mapping keys in direct raw and wrapped argument models.
tests.rationale: Both raw dictionary and LiteralOperand cases require the structured mapping-key issue and serializer ValueError. These protect two public boundaries intentionally.

tests.name: test_persistence_disambiguates_mapping_data_and_dynamic_argument_operands
tests.purpose: Preserve operand-shaped raw mappings and nested dynamic operands in persistence.
tests.rationale: Direct model contains field/literal/reserved keys, nested FieldOperand and tuple operands; checks validation, full model equality, content hash, concrete mapping type and format tag.

tests.name: test_persistence_codec_reports_unhashable_set_arguments_as_value_errors
tests.purpose: Translate malformed persisted set elements into the codec domain exception.
tests.rationale: Mutates encoded argument set members to a list or a tagged mapping and requires ValueError with hashability context, reaching the exact formerly leaking set-construction branch.

tests.name: test_persistence_preserves_binary_float_and_decimal_kinds_without_authoring_coercion
tests.purpose: Preserve float, Decimal and int kinds in directly constructed persisted literals.
tests.rationale: Exact element-type assertions supplement dataclass equality, which alone cannot distinguish equal float/Decimal/int values. This is essential persistence coverage.

tests.name: test_json_ready_graph_preserves_decimal_precision_and_all_literal_kinds
tests.purpose: Preserve exact numeric kinds, Decimal scale, tuple/set containers and escaped mapping data in JSON-ready graphs.
tests.rationale: Round-trips through ordinary json.dumps/loads, checks scalar types and Decimal tuples, and includes reserved-key data. Temporal literal kinds are covered by serializer tests; the name could be narrowed but the asserted contract is useful.

tests.name: test_json_ready_decimal_envelope_rejects_malformed_or_nonfinite_values
tests.purpose: Reject nonstring, malformed and nonfinite Decimal envelopes.
tests.rationale: Four malformed values require a decimal-specific ValueError through the JSON-ready decoder; complements the other envelope types tested in test_serializer.py.

tests.name: test_persistence_rejects_row_identity_disagreement
tests.purpose: Reject disagreement between row identity fields and authoritative payload identity.
tests.rationale: Independently changes ruleset_id, ruleset_name and version while leaving payload/hash valid, and requires the mismatched field in RepositoryError.

tests.name: test_persistence_verifies_hash_before_deserializing_payload
tests.purpose: Verify content integrity before parsing persisted JSON.
tests.rationale: One valid document with a wrong hash checks integrity; malformed JSON with a stale hash must still report hash mismatch, making verification order observable.

tests.name: test_persistence_reports_unsupported_or_malformed_documents
tests.purpose: Report unsupported format versions, noncanonical extras and missing required fields uniformly.
tests.rationale: Recomputes hashes for deliberately changed documents so validation reaches decoding/canonicality checks instead of failing earlier at integrity verification.

tests.name: test_persistence_rejects_duplicate_json_keys_even_with_a_matching_hash
tests.purpose: Reject duplicate JSON keys before parsing can overwrite authoritative identity.
tests.rationale: Appends a duplicate version key and recomputes integrity hash; the expected duplicate-key RepositoryError specifically tests the object_pairs_hook boundary.

tests.name: test_shared_traversal_respects_active_filters_and_literal_boundaries
tests.purpose: Filter inactive conditions while treating literal contents as opaque data.
tests.rationale: Compares default and active-only condition traversal, then checks the exact two operand types under an active assignment containing literal field-shaped data. Basic traversal contract remains production-used.

tests.name: test_compile_text_preserves_untyped_fractional_yaml_as_decimal
tests.purpose: Parse YAML fractional scalars without binary-float precision loss.
tests.rationale: Exercises compile_text and the Decimal-aware YAML loader in both condition and shorthand-assignment positions; the 21-digit literal would expose a float intermediate.

tests.name: test_valid_simple_row_rule_compiles_and_validates
tests.purpose: Compile a basic rule, preserve owner metadata, parse eq, and materialize zero tolerance.
tests.rationale: The owner/operator/tolerance assertions exercise useful compiler defaults, but the named validation step never occurs; semantic validation is intentionally a separate production API.

tests.name: test_condition_uses_no_match_as_the_default_null_semantics
tests.purpose: Compile omitted null options into the default condition/operand metadata.
tests.rationale: Asserts error_on_null is False and both operand defaults are None. It verifies compilation of defaults; runtime null behavior is correctly covered elsewhere.

tests.name: test_operand_default_if_null_supports_scalar_and_typed_literals
tests.purpose: Compile scalar and explicitly typed decimal null fallbacks.
tests.rationale: Checks both fallback values and the decimal value_type, exercising the shorthand and explicit default_if_null parsing branches.

tests.name: test_assigned_operand_compiles_as_a_custom_function_argument
tests.purpose: Recognize an assigned reference and its fallback inside function arguments.
tests.rationale: Inspects the nested argument type, target_field and fallback. This covers the function-argument dispatch boundary beyond the direct assigned-operand test.

tests.name: test_custom_function_arguments_compile_operands_inside_collections
tests.purpose: Recognize field operands in a function-argument array.
tests.rationale: Checks exact FieldOperand types and ordered field names in a list, so leaving argument dictionaries raw fails. Array coverage complements mapping-escape tests.

tests.name: test_custom_function_mapping_escape_preserves_data_keys_and_nested_operands
tests.purpose: Decode a raw argument mapping escape without losing nested operands or reserved data keys.
tests.rationale: Exact expected dictionary distinguishes ordinary field/reserved keys from the FieldOperand under dynamic; directly tests compiler syntax independently of exporter round trips.

tests.name: test_custom_function_mapping_escape_rejects_malformed_shapes
tests.purpose: Reject malformed mapping escapes and extra sibling keys.
tests.rationale: Four cases require CompilationError with mapping/unsupported-key diagnostics, covering non-mapping payloads and escape exclusivity.

tests.name: test_assigned_operand_compiles_with_a_null_fallback
tests.purpose: Compile direct assigned references with an explicit null fallback.
tests.rationale: Checks concrete AssignedOperand type, target and fallback through condition parsing. Distinct entry path from assigned references inside function arguments.

tests.name: test_nonfinite_yaml_numbers_fail_compilation
tests.purpose: Reject YAML NaN and positive/negative infinity tokens in the loader boundary.
tests.rationale: Uses compile_text and three actual YAML spellings; CompilationError plus finite diagnostic catches both acceptance and leaked YAML exceptions.

tests.name: test_nonfinite_explicit_numeric_payloads_fail_compilation
tests.purpose: Reject nonfinite Python payload values even with explicit numeric hints.
tests.rationale: Four cases call compile_payload instead of the YAML loader, independently checking canonical literal validation and its compiler exception translation.

tests.name: test_explicit_decimal_collection_is_normalized_recursively
tests.purpose: Normalize every nested item under a decimal collection hint.
tests.rationale: The two string items prove first-level list element conversion, but the fixture has no nested collection and cannot detect a one-level-only implementation.

tests.name: test_explicit_date_literal_normalizes_quoted_iso_text
tests.purpose: Convert an explicit ISO date string into a Python date.
tests.rationale: Uses a valid leap-day date and exact date equality; bypassing conversion leaves a string and fails. Distinct positive case from rejected compact/week date spellings.

tests.name: test_explicit_timestamp_literals_normalize_to_datetime
tests.purpose: Normalize timestamp and timestamp_ntz text to their declared datetime representations.
tests.rationale: Confirms datetime values and aware-versus-naive semantics, but aware equality permits the original +05:00 timezone to survive instead of canonical UTC.

tests.name: test_explicit_timestamp_literals_enforce_offset_representation
tests.purpose: Reject aware text for timestamp_ntz and naive text for timestamp.
tests.rationale: Both representation reversals require CompilationError naming the declared type; this protects compiler exception translation beyond converter unit coverage.

tests.name: test_boolean_literal_hint_requires_an_actual_boolean
tests.purpose: Reject quoted boolean-looking strings under both boolean hint aliases.
tests.rationale: Both boolean and bool hints exercise the same public authoring contract and require the actual-boolean diagnostic rather than truthiness coercion.

tests.name: test_known_scalar_literal_hints_normalize_to_their_runtime_type
tests.purpose: Normalize supported scalar hints and aliases to exact runtime scalar types.
tests.rationale: Each case asserts value plus exact Python type, which avoids int/float/Decimal equality masking conversion failures.

tests.name: test_known_scalar_literal_hints_reject_incompatible_values
tests.purpose: Reject wrong scalar kinds, fractional integers and integer overflow at compilation.
tests.rationale: The eight independent cases require type-specific diagnostics, covering bool exclusion, numeric-only inputs, fractional loss and signed-64-bit limits.

tests.name: test_known_scalar_literal_hints_validate_collection_items_recursively
tests.purpose: Reject incompatible typed items throughout nested collections.
tests.rationale: The invalid string is a direct member of a flat list, proving element validation but not recursive descent into nested list/tuple/mapping structures.

tests.name: test_unknown_literal_hint_is_preserved_as_extension_metadata
tests.purpose: Preserve an extension type hint without coercing its value.
tests.rationale: Checks both the UUID text and unknown uuid value_type. Protects the intentional extension branch from blanket rejection or conversion.

tests.name: test_explicit_date_literal_rejects_noncanonical_iso_forms
tests.purpose: Accept only the documented YYYY-MM-DD authoring spelling for date strings.
tests.rationale: Compact and ISO-week forms are accepted by Python date parsing but must be rejected here, so these are useful nonredundant boundary cases.

tests.name: test_canonical_string_operators_compile
tests.purpose: Compile the four canonical contains/prefix/suffix operator spellings.
tests.rationale: Compares the ordered compiled enum values to independent literal strings, catching missing or renamed parsing support; runtime semantics belong in runtime tests.

tests.name: test_unknown_mapping_keys_are_rejected_at_every_contract_level
tests.purpose: Reject unsupported keys at every structured authoring mapping boundary.
tests.rationale: Covers ruleset, rule, condition, assignment and inner function mappings, but never exercises condition groups or operand mappings, which have separate closed-key checks.

tests.name: test_mixed_type_unsupported_keys_raise_compilation_error
tests.purpose: Avoid Python sorting errors when unsupported keys have mixed types.
tests.rationale: Only one unsupported integer key is added. The unsupported set has length one, so sorting raw mixed keys is never attempted; the exact unsafe sorting regression survives.

tests.name: test_required_authoring_text_rejects_whitespace_only_values
tests.purpose: Reject blank identifiers, names and field targets in authoring input.
tests.rationale: Seven independently reset payload paths plus a shorthand assignment target require the nonempty-string diagnostic. Shared string-helper coverage makes the fixture meaningful without asserting every field.

tests.name: test_literal_mapping_keys_cannot_collide_after_string_normalization
tests.purpose: Reject distinct literal keys that normalize to the same string.
tests.rationale: Uses integer 1 and string 1 in the same literal mapping and requires the collision diagnostic through compiler exception translation.

tests.name: test_nested_function_argument_mapping_keys_cannot_collapse
tests.purpose: Apply canonical key-collision checks recursively to raw function argument mappings.
tests.rationale: Places colliding keys under config/nested, a separate argument walker from literal normalization. This is valuable layered coverage, not a duplicate of the literal test.

tests.name: test_root_wrapper_is_not_part_of_the_ruleset_contract
tests.purpose: Reject the removed outer ruleset wrapper syntax.
tests.rationale: Specifically guards an obsolete authoring shape that generic unknown-key tests do not identify. Its named compatibility boundary justifies a small separate regression.

tests.name: test_unknown_operand_kind_is_rejected_generically
tests.purpose: Reject an operand dictionary with none of the four supported kind keys.
tests.rationale: Requires the exactly-one-kind CompilationError from operand dispatch; distinct from extra-key rejection after a valid kind was recognized.

tests.name: test_rule_scalar_types_are_not_coerced
tests.purpose: Reject string rule order, string active flags and numeric stop flags.
tests.rationale: Each invalid metadata value targets the explicit integer/boolean reader and matches the relevant field diagnostic.

tests.name: test_generated_assignment_ids_are_stable_by_rule_and_target
tests.purpose: Generate rule-and-target assignment IDs independently of map insertion order.
tests.rationale: Compiles differently ordered assignment mappings and compares both to independently written ID dictionaries, avoiding a shared implementation oracle.

tests.name: test_explicit_assignment_list_uses_stable_generated_id_when_omitted
tests.purpose: Apply the same generated-ID contract to list-form assignments.
tests.rationale: Checks the exact rule-and-target ID through the distinct list-form _str_or_default path; mapping-form stability alone would not cover it.

tests.name: test_duplicate_yaml_mapping_keys_fail_compilation
tests.purpose: Reject duplicate explicit YAML mapping keys before the loader overwrites data.
tests.rationale: Uses duplicate RateCode entries in actual YAML and requires a duplicate-key CompilationError, directly exercising the custom loader.

tests.name: test_yaml_merge_allows_explicit_key_override
tests.purpose: Preserve legal explicit overrides of YAML merged mappings.
tests.rationale: Exercises a real anchor/merge pair and verifies the overriding value, providing the necessary positive counterexample to strict duplicate-key rejection.

tests.name: test_shipped_rulesets_validate_and_round_trip_hash_stably
tests.purpose: Keep every shipped YAML example valid and stable through export/recompile.
tests.rationale: Runs on the five currently tracked shipped YAML artifacts, requires semantic validation plus full model/hash equality, and guards documentation fixtures as an integration contract.

tests.name: test_yaml_export_round_trips_compiled_ruleset
tests.purpose: Preserve compiled rule metadata, groups, operands, assignments and exact decimals through YAML export.
tests.rationale: Rich fixture checks model equality plus independently inspected owner and lifecycle-key output. Appropriate exporter/compiler integration; direct-model numeric kinds need separate coverage.

tests.name: test_yaml_export_text_is_stable_after_recompilation
tests.purpose: Produce stable review text and preserve tuple/set/date/Decimal values across recompilation.
tests.rationale: Checks first/second text equality, model/hash equality, safe tuple tagging and a fixed condition-key order. Strong idempotence oracle, complementary to canonical JSON insertion-order checks.

tests.name: test_yaml_exporter_preserves_operands_inside_function_argument_arrays
tests.purpose: Preserve dynamic operands inside exported function argument arrays.
tests.rationale: Array FieldOperands pass through exporter and compiler and must match the original tree; this is a different boundary than compiler-only array parsing.

tests.name: test_operand_shaped_argument_mappings_survive_yaml_round_trip
tests.purpose: Keep persisted raw operand-shaped mappings and nested operands identical through YAML review.
tests.rationale: Nine cases thoroughly cover syntax collisions, but omit untyped binary floats. Running this same function with mapping={field: 1.5} currently fails its hash assertion after float becomes Decimal.

tests.name: test_yaml_export_round_trips_assigned_operands
tests.purpose: Preserve prior-assignment references in both conditions and assignments.
tests.rationale: Two-rule fixture tests defaulted and nondefaulted assigned operands, with model equality and literal assigned YAML spelling; distinct exporter branch worth retaining.

tests.name: test_yaml_export_emits_the_exact_rule_contract
tests.purpose: Emit the documented explicit rule/condition shape with canonical omitted defaults.
tests.rationale: Inspects exact rule and condition key sets, simple literal operand shapes and generated group identity independently of compiler equality, catching mirrored producer/consumer changes.

tests.name: test_public_coverage_export_and_metadata_versions_stay_aligned
tests.purpose: The documented analyzer imports publicly and registry metadata uses engine version.
tests.rationale: Public analyzer import and standard/engine version equality protect installed API wiring. Small but different from evaluating coverage statistics.

tests.name: test_non_boolean_full_audit_fails_before_spark_execution
tests.purpose: String truthiness cannot silently enable the expensive audit contract.
tests.rationale: Exercises result_field_names directly with a truthy string and requires its typed error. Complements builder-level boolean-option checks at a different public entry point.

tests.name: test_python_evaluator_and_spark_worker_share_rule_ordering_semantics
tests.purpose: The compact Python and Spark-worker paths share ordering and stop semantics.
tests.rationale: Both sides use the shared row executor and rules are already sorted. Removing execution sorting survives. Preserve adapter parity but scramble metadata and add independent expected results.

tests.name: test_notebook_discovers_a_standalone_checkout
tests.purpose: The shipped bootstrap works from a nested directory using tracked layout markers.
tests.rationale: Executes each shipped root-discovery AST assignment from a temporary nested checkout lacking databricks.yml. Proves only bootstrap discovery, correctly described; four notebook parameters protect four copies.

tests.name: test_publish_passes_provenance_to_repository
tests.purpose: Passes published_by during direct publication.
tests.rationale: Explicit actor changes the recording repository from None to approver after real semantic validation. Would fail if publication or actor forwarding were removed.

tests.name: test_publish_allows_omitted_provenance
tests.purpose: Allows publish callers to omit actor metadata.
tests.rationale: Repository actor starts as None, the exact asserted final value. Replacing publication with a no-op passes. Also assert a write occurred with the original ruleset.

tests.name: test_publish_blocks_invalid_ruleset_before_repository_write
tests.purpose: Semantic validation remains the only publication gate.
tests.rationale: A missing owner produces the specific ValidationFailedError and leaves saved metadata untouched. Directly protects validation-before-write ordering.

tests.name: test_save_published_rejects_duplicate_ruleset_name_and_version
tests.purpose: Rejects duplicate caller-facing ruleset identities.
tests.rationale: Stubbed name/version collision raises the caller-facing identity error even with a different ID. Isolates the publication policy; lookup predicates need separate tests.

tests.name: test_save_published_rejects_duplicate_ruleset_id_and_version
tests.purpose: Stable ruleset IDs cannot identify more than one row per version.
tests.rationale: Stubbed ID/version collision rejects a different display name. Necessary complement to the caller-facing identity guard.

tests.name: test_save_published_allows_distinct_versions_for_same_ruleset_name
tests.purpose: Allows two published versions with the same ruleset_name when their versions differ.
tests.rationale: Only version 2 is saved, and both identity lookups always return None. It proves an empty-repository append, not coexistence with a published sibling.

tests.name: test_save_published_requires_explicit_table_creation
tests.purpose: Publication cannot create the ruleset metadata table as a write side effect.
tests.rationale: A missing catalog table must raise RepositoryError before frame creation. This reaches the real write guard through publication and complements the successful writer-shape test.

tests.name: test_load_published_requires_explicit_table_creation
tests.purpose: Loading a missing metadata table fails through the repository contract.
tests.rationale: A missing catalog table fails at the load boundary with the repository error. Independent of the publication path.

tests.name: test_load_published_rejects_duplicate_rows_for_explicit_version
tests.purpose: Pinned loads fail loudly when the immutable version key is not unique.
tests.rationale: Two rows from a bounded fake lookup produce the pinned-version ambiguity error. Correct count-policy unit test; the fake deliberately does not exercise SQL predicates.

tests.name: test_retire_rejects_duplicate_stable_identity_before_update
tests.purpose: Retirement cannot update several rows sharing one stable identity.
tests.rationale: Two stable-identity rows stop retirement before SQL is issued. Protects the unsafe-multi-row update guard independently of load ambiguity.

tests.name: test_retire_records_lifecycle_state_and_actor
tests.purpose: Retirement updates lifecycle status and audit fields.
tests.rationale: Captures parameterized lifecycle SQL and exact actor/time/identity values, and supplies a verified post-update row. A useful generated-query contract, not proof of a Delta transaction.

tests.name: test_retire_binds_backslashes_and_quotes_as_sql_parameters
tests.purpose: Authored values remain data even when Spark string-literal escaping would be unsafe.
tests.rationale: Adversarial quotes and backslashes must stay out of SQL text and appear unchanged in bound parameters. Adds injection-relevant evidence beyond the ordinary lifecycle case.

tests.name: test_retire_does_not_overwrite_a_concurrent_retirement
tests.purpose: A caller that loses the published-to-retired race fails without replacing audit data.
tests.rationale: Simulated losing post-update state must fail and SQL must retain the published-status predicate. Valuable optimistic-state unit test; actual concurrent Delta execution remains outside its scope.

tests.name: test_retire_rejects_already_retired_version
tests.purpose: Rejects a second retirement for an already retired version.
tests.rationale: An already-retired row raises before any SQL call, preserving existing actor/time. Distinct precondition from the simulated race case.

tests.name: test_save_function_registry_rows_skips_existing_rows_when_update_disabled
tests.purpose: Emits an insert-only merge when update_existing is disabled.
tests.rationale: Checks insert-only MERGE text and staging-view cleanup. Verifies query construction, not actual row updates; retain alongside target Delta acceptance.

tests.name: test_save_function_registry_rows_upserts_by_default
tests.purpose: Keeps custom function registry saves as upserts by default.
tests.rationale: Default registry saves contain both UPDATE and INSERT clauses. Different externally selected policy from update_existing=False.

tests.name: test_save_function_registry_rows_requires_explicit_table_creation
tests.purpose: Registry persistence cannot create its Delta table as a write side effect.
tests.rationale: Missing registry table fails before staging frame construction. The function-registry path has its own existence guard.

tests.name: test_write_rows_appends_by_name_only_after_table_existence_check
tests.purpose: Existing metadata writes align columns by name and cannot create on a failed check.
tests.rationale: Asserts Delta/append/saveAsTable API use for an existing table; it never supplies a failed existence check or records call order. Narrow the purpose or add that direct negative branch; publication tests already guard missing tables.

tests.name: test_ruleset_version_schema_contains_payload_provenance_and_hash_fields
tests.purpose: Verifies the ruleset version schema exposes payload, count, provenance, and hash columns.
tests.rationale: Checks the specified payload/count/ownership/lifecycle columns exist. Appropriate required-column subset guard; it does not claim exact field types or full DDL/schema equivalence.

tests.name: test_function_registry_model_and_table_field_names_stay_aligned
tests.purpose: Registry model renames cannot silently drift from the Delta schema.
tests.rationale: Compares independent dataclass and Spark schema names, explicitly mapping the JSON-backed argument column. Catches model/schema naming drift.

tests.name: test_table_names_can_be_built_from_schema
tests.purpose: Builds the standard two-table registry footprint from one schema name.
tests.rationale: Checks exact fully qualified default table names on the table-name factory. Service-level wiring tests exercise a separate caller.

tests.name: test_table_names_reject_unsafe_spark_identifiers
tests.purpose: Operator-provided table names cannot escape into generated Spark SQL.
tests.rationale: Rejects SQL punctuation, empty identifier segments and excessive qualification through the public table-name type. Three distinct parser failures.

tests.name: test_create_base_tables_uses_explicit_delta_ddl_with_not_null_columns
tests.purpose: Creates metadata tables through SQL DDL with NOT NULL columns.
tests.rationale: Fails on any DataFrame-based bootstrap, checks both DROP/CREATE pairs, selected NOT NULL fields and Delta format. Correct unit protection for the former bootstrap mechanism.

tests.name: test_create_base_tables_uses_if_not_exists_for_ignore_mode
tests.purpose: Uses CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for idempotent bootstrap.
tests.rationale: Requires IF NOT EXISTS on both tables and forbids DROP. Separately protects the non-destructive bootstrap option.

tests.name: test_required_columns_match_prepared_schema_across_active_operand_trees
tests.purpose: Public and prepared-schema dependency traversal remain identical and ordered.
tests.rationale: Two metadata orders with nested operands in mapping/list/tuple/set, literal lookalike keys, defaults, assigned state, inactive references and duplicates must pass validation and equal an independent exact tuple; catches both agreement regressions and equal-but-wrong traversal.

tests.name: test_assigned_values_are_visible_to_later_rules_and_atomic_within_a_rule
tests.purpose: Later rules consume commits while sibling assignments share the prior snapshot.
tests.rationale: Exact full business result requires producer/consumer matches, original bucket visibility, score=20 and copied_score=10; catches sequential sibling commits. Execution order is already authored ascending, so not an ordering-shuffle test.

tests.name: test_missing_prior_commit_is_null_and_can_use_default_if_null
tests.purpose: An unmatched producer leaves absent assigned state eligible for a fallback.
tests.rationale: False producer plus fallback consumer must produce only review=True and bucket unapplied/null; distinct from literal/field fallback tests because it exercises assigned-state lookup.

tests.name: test_full_audit_identifies_the_assignment_that_produced_an_operand
tests.purpose: Assigned-operand audit identifies the originating rule and assignment.
tests.rationale: Asserts assigned kind, consumed target/value and both producer IDs from the second rule's condition; protects provenance not covered by plain result parity.

tests.name: test_numeric_membership_uses_decimal_equality
tests.purpose: Worker float membership respects exact decimal-authored collection values.
tests.rationale: YAML text produces Decimal literals and a Python float row is checked under IN and NOT_IN, with explicit no-error and opposite expected outcomes; protects numeric membership's _equals delegation.

tests.name: test_string_membership_uses_exact_case_sensitive_equality
tests.purpose: Membership keeps ordinary strings case-sensitive.
tests.rationale: OPEN matches the collection and open does not; exercises collection membership independently of numeric conversion. The false case alone could be an error, but the paired positive and direct comparison path make this useful behavioral coverage.

tests.name: test_numeric_looking_strings_keep_exact_code_equality
tests.purpose: Numeric-looking identifiers retain exact string equality.
tests.rationale: Four deliberately different representations run EQ/NE/IN/NOT_IN with complementary expectations, catching undesired Decimal coercion of two strings. These cases differ semantically from numeric float equality.

tests.name: test_real_numeric_values_still_use_decimal_equality
tests.purpose: A worker float equals a Decimal literal with the same authored decimal value.
tests.rationale: 0.0425 versus Decimal('0.0425') distinguishes decimal-text equality from binary-float/Decimal equality; complements the string identity and membership cases.

tests.name: test_scalar_string_membership_fails_with_contains_guidance
tests.purpose: IN rejects a dynamically supplied scalar string with actionable guidance.
tests.rationale: Field-backed right operand reaches runtime validation and asserts unmatched plus contains/not_contains guidance; still needed despite static validator tests because schema cannot prove every dynamic return shape.

tests.name: test_result_payload_keys_match_the_declared_schema
tests.purpose: Payload keys match declared compact/audit schemas and error payloads are isolated.
tests.rationale: Compares both success/error key order to Spark StructType names, then mutates one error's nested assign entry and checks another error/template unchanged; also checks fresh audit/list containers. This is a direct payload-contract unit test, not a live Spark conversion test.

tests.name: test_dataframe_evaluation_reserves_every_output_name_in_compact_mode
tests.purpose: Compact evaluation rejects collisions with core output columns.
tests.rationale: Each of six hardcoded suffixes reaches public preflight and requires its exact conflicting name in the ValueError. Cheap metadata-only frame is appropriate because rejection must occur before schema/Spark access.

tests.name: test_compact_evaluation_reserves_full_audit_only_names
tests.purpose: Compact plans reserve the two audit-only output names.
tests.rationale: Checks matched_rules and assignment_results collisions through the same preflight branch as the core output-name parameterization; valuable variants but can join that parameter table instead of duplicating the fixture/body.

tests.name: test_dataframe_evaluation_reserves_output_names_case_insensitively
tests.purpose: Output-column collisions respect Spark's case-insensitive resolver.
tests.rationale: Mixed-case Rules_Engine_Matched must fail with the original spelling; distinct casing branch from exact suffix tests.

tests.name: test_dataframe_evaluation_rejects_an_empty_column_prefix
tests.purpose: An empty namespace fails before Spark plan work.
tests.rationale: Public evaluate_dataframe is given a metadata-only frame and empty prefix; exact diagnostic is asserted, so missing schema cannot accidentally satisfy the expected failure.

tests.name: test_dataframe_evaluation_rejects_invalid_key_metadata
tests.purpose: Invalid key argument shapes are rejected without data actions.
tests.rationale: String, empty, duplicate, case duplicate, missing and non-string keys require their intended diagnostics; metadata-only frame ensures any accidental plan access fails differently.

tests.name: test_dataframe_evaluation_rejects_an_ambiguous_key_column
tests.purpose: Repeated source names cannot identify a deterministic key.
tests.rationale: Duplicate row_id source columns require ambiguous-name failure; necessary case but the same branch/fixture can be a row in one source-ambiguity parameter table.

tests.name: test_dataframe_evaluation_rejects_a_case_ambiguous_key_column
tests.purpose: Case-only duplicate source keys are rejected.
tests.rationale: row_id and ROW_ID collide under casefold and must fail before plan access; meaningful variant of the source-ambiguity table, not a distinct implementation path requiring a separate fixture.

tests.name: test_dataframe_evaluation_rejects_unselected_ambiguous_source_columns
tests.purpose: Ambiguous non-key columns are rejected before later source projection.
tests.rationale: Foo/foo duplicates are deliberately excluded from selected row_id, proving all source columns are checked; keep this distinct table case when consolidating the three ambiguity tests.

tests.name: test_dataframe_evaluation_rejects_assignment_to_an_immutable_key
tests.purpose: A rule cannot assign into a selected correlation key.
tests.rationale: Active row_id assignment must fail public preflight with immutable-key guidance. This guards a different invariant from duplicate/missing key metadata.

tests.name: test_dataframe_evaluation_protects_keys_from_case_only_assignment_targets
tests.purpose: Case-only spelling cannot bypass immutable-key protection.
tests.rationale: Lowercase target row_id against source/key ROW_ID must emit the immutable-key diagnostic; useful companion to exact spelling.

tests.name: test_dataframe_evaluation_defaults_keys_to_all_input_columns
tests.purpose: Omitted keys expand to source columns in source order.
tests.rationale: Direct production _validate_key_columns call requires exact three-column tuple; focused normalization coverage rather than a claim of full DataFrame application.

tests.name: test_dataframe_evaluation_default_keys_protect_every_input_column
tests.purpose: Implicit full-source keys prevent existing source overwrites.
tests.rationale: Public evaluation omits key_columns and attempts account assignment, requiring account in the error; complements the positive default-key tuple assertion.

tests.name: test_assignment_provenance_tracks_immediate_override_and_final_winner
tests.purpose: Audit provenance distinguishes next overwrite from final winner per target.
tests.rationale: Hand-authored interleaved events assert full next/final IDs, effective status, stable event order and schema-key order; independent expected results exercise _assignment_results indexing more thoroughly than the two-rule integration example.

tests.name: test_set_trace_text_is_deterministic
tests.purpose: Unordered trace values render in sorted order.
tests.rationale: Checks exact '[alpha, beta]' from an unordered set via the production Spark trace helper; fast deterministic rendering regression, although it does not spawn multiple hash-seeded workers.

tests.name: test_human_readable_values_sort_sets_and_use_iso_temporal_text
tests.purpose: Authored expressions render sets and temporal values deterministically.
tests.rationale: Exact rule_logic and match_payload assert sorted quoted set values and ISO offset datetime text via HumanReadableRulesetFormatter; different formatting layer from Spark trace text, so not duplicate coverage.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_orders_date_operands
tests.purpose: Date operands support all ordered comparison operators.
tests.rationale: Five operator/date cases assert no error and expected result, including equality for GE/LE and a false GT; invokes the current temporal comparison branch through the worker adapter.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_orders_date_ranges
tests.purpose: Date values can be compared with date range bounds.
tests.rationale: BETWEEN and NOT_BETWEEN run the same interior date with opposite expected outputs and no error; useful temporal range path, not an endpoint-inclusivity test.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_rejects_malformed_between_bounds
tests.purpose: Dynamic range bounds require a two-item list/tuple.
tests.rationale: Three field-backed invalid shapes assert the actionable range diagnostic; bypassing preflight is intentional to test invalid runtime values that metadata cannot rule out.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_orders_timezone_aware_timestamps
tests.purpose: Aware timestamps support ordered comparisons.
tests.rationale: One UTC-aware GT case must match without error; boundary module separately covers local naive decoder values, so the tests cover different conversion layers.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_rejects_ambiguous_temporal_comparisons
tests.purpose: Date/timestamp and aware/naive mismatches fail clearly.
tests.rationale: Two concrete invalid Python runtime type pairings must emit their distinct temporal errors; these retain value as worker defenses despite static schema validation coverage.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_rejects_numeric_tolerance_for_dates
tests.purpose: Temporal comparisons reject nonzero numeric tolerance.
tests.rationale: Date GE with tolerance=1 must produce the tolerance_abs=0 diagnostic; directly checks the runtime temporal contract.

tests.name: test_required_source_columns_returns_only_active_runtime_dependencies
tests.purpose: Public projection discovery returns ordered active dependencies only.
tests.rationale: Intentionally scrambled rule order, duplicate nested function reference, inactive condition/rule and assignment references produce an exact tuple; also checks the package's public alias. Broader prepared-schema parity test complements this public API smoke test.

tests.name: test_required_source_columns_can_return_no_dependencies
tests.purpose: Literal-only rules require no source columns.
tests.rationale: Public helper must return exactly (); protects zero-dependency discovery. Actual empty Spark struct fallback is an integration concern handled elsewhere.

tests.name: test_required_source_columns_does_not_treat_assigned_targets_as_input_fields
tests.purpose: Internal assigned-state references do not enlarge the source projection.
tests.rationale: Assigned chain must yield only eligible and the independently authored original bucket field, omitting score/copied_score; documents a focused public projection contract despite overlap with the larger parity fixture.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_returns_native_matched_rule_trace
tests.purpose: Worker output contains structured matched-rule and operand audit data.
tests.rationale: Asserts native dictionaries, absence of legacy rule_results, rule/group/condition identity, explanation and source/value detail alongside actual assignment; substantial adapter contract test.

tests.name: test_full_audit_distinguishes_inactive_conditions
tests.purpose: Audit preserves inactive condition identity without reporting a comparison result.
tests.rationale: An ANY group includes inactive and active matching branches; requires both traces in order, inactive comparison=None, active=True, and shared group identity/operator.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_trace_shows_operand_default_application
tests.purpose: Full audit exposes original null, fallback and effective operand value.
tests.rationale: Exact left/right default_applied flags, original null, fallback and effective UNKNOWN assertions distinguish substitution from mere final-value correctness.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_assignment_struct_includes_unassigned_fields_as_null
tests.purpose: Worker assignments retain unassigned nullable targets.
tests.rationale: Two mutually exclusive rules and both declared output fields require one applied value and one unapplied/null object. Explicit assign_fields scopes this to stable payload construction, not field inference.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_match_trace_explanation_uses_any_joiner
tests.purpose: Multiple passing ANY branches use OR in explanations.
tests.rationale: Both fields pass and exact OR string is asserted; catches flattening into AND independently of nested grouping/pruning cases.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_match_trace_explanation_drops_failing_any_branches
tests.purpose: Failed root OR branches are omitted from the match explanation.
tests.rationale: One passed and one failed field branch require the exact surviving expression, checking filtering rather than only whether the rule matches.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_match_trace_explanation_preserves_nested_groups
tests.purpose: Nested passing groups retain parentheses and logical operators.
tests.rationale: Root ALL plus nested two-way ANY must produce an exact parenthesized AND/OR string; regression distinguishes tree-aware rendering from flat trace joining.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_match_trace_explanation_drops_failing_nested_or_arm
tests.purpose: Failed nested OR arms are pruned without losing the passed path.
tests.rationale: One false nested condition requires exact simplified root-AND expression; differs from root-only pruning because nested parentheses/group collapse are exercised.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_match_trace_explanation_matches_service_formatter
tests.purpose: Runtime explanations and service formatting use the same authored syntax.
tests.rationale: Worker explanation is compared to the public formatter for two passing conditions. Shared formatter is an appropriate oracle for this consistency contract; literal strings in neighboring tests independently pin the actual syntax.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_preserves_mapping_literal_assignment_as_struct
tests.purpose: Mapping assignments keep inferred nested schema and native values.
tests.rationale: Checks validator's StructType with BooleanType leaves plus exact worker assignment dictionary; tests both schema selection and runtime conversion without pretending to cross the JVM.

tests.name: test_spark_assignment_schema_ignores_inactive_rules
tests.purpose: Inactive assignments neither conflict with live types nor add outputs.
tests.rationale: Active struct assignment and inactive string conflict/inactive-only target must yield only the active struct in both public assignment_schema and worker payload; still follows production validator code after removal of runtime's old _assignment_schema wrapper.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_merges_assignments_when_stop_on_match_false
tests.purpose: Multiple matches merge assignments using last writer wins and retain audit history.
tests.rationale: Explicit expected IDs/assignments, cleared-null application, changed flags, override IDs and compact parity cover multiple contracts. Repeated identical rule/explanation assertions are unnecessary lines, and fresh-worker identity checks do not demonstrate same-worker row isolation, but the test's central merge purpose is strongly met.

tests.name: test_compact_and_full_audit_payloads_have_core_result_parity
tests.purpose: Audit detail preserves success, no-match and error business outcomes.
tests.rationale: Three concrete rows compare all compact fields and independently assert expected assignments/matches/errors and audit-array emptiness; independent expected values prevent equal-but-wrong parity from passing.

tests.name: test_full_audit_builds_explanations_only_for_matched_rules
tests.purpose: Only matching rows invoke the expensive explanation formatter.
tests.rationale: A formatter spy around one matching and one losing row observes one call after worker construction. Useful focused performance regression; it does not independently count condition invocations mentioned in the docstring.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_rejects_lossy_decimal_assignment_coercion
tests.purpose: Worker normalization rejects decimal values requiring scale loss.
tests.rationale: A 19-fractional-digit typed decimal hits the runtime normalizer and must mention 'without rounding'; intentionally bypasses static preflight so runtime defense is exercised rather than an already-rejected plan.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_rejects_fractional_integer_function_return
tests.purpose: A function's integer declaration cannot silently truncate its fractional result.
tests.rationale: Registered integer-returning function actually emits 3.7; worker must report fractional-component loss. This runtime-value check cannot be replaced by static return-hint validation.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_stop_on_match_excludes_later_traces_and_assignments
tests.purpose: A first stop-on-match rule prevents later rule audit results.
tests.rationale: Both rules would match, but exact matched IDs, rule trace IDs and assignment event IDs contain only r1. Central stop handling remains production code; output values are covered by other chain cases.

tests.name: test_full_audit_evaluates_each_condition_once_and_emits_only_matched_traces
tests.purpose: Full audit evaluates each condition once and emits only matching rule traces.
tests.rationale: Spies _condition_trace construction rather than operand/function evaluation and only checks matched_rules[0], so duplicate resolutions or additional later losing traces can escape; a mutation probe duplicated every condition's operand resolution and the test stayed green.

tests.name: test_losing_custom_condition_is_invoked_once_during_full_audit
tests.purpose: A losing custom function executes once while scanning for a later match.
tests.rationale: Actual callable side-effect list must contain exactly one resolved argument mapping, and IDs must contain only plain_match; genuine function-invocation coverage, complementary to the broader trace-count test.

tests.name: test_base_payload_field_construction_is_hoisted_out_of_row_evaluation
tests.purpose: Stable payload field enumeration happens once per worker build.
tests.rationale: Spy on result_field_names records exactly [True] after two calls on the same worker, following its only _base_payload construction path; justified targeted allocation/performance regression rather than elapsed-time assertion.

tests.name: test_match_only_losing_rule_preserves_later_condition_errors
tests.purpose: Compact evaluation still visits an erroneous later condition after a false first condition.
tests.rationale: _evaluate_worker defaults to full_audit=True and this call does not override it, so only _evaluate_rule runs; probe replaced _rule_matches with a failure and observed zero calls while the test passed. Must explicitly run compact mode, ideally compare both modes.

tests.name: test_match_only_and_traced_paths_agree_on_inactive_condition_groups
tests.purpose: Compact and traced group logic treat inactive conditions as false.
tests.rationale: Calls both production private rule entry points for ALL and ANY with explicit False/True expected values; no custom binding/preparation is needed for the field/literal fixture.

tests.name: test_inactive_custom_condition_does_not_require_a_worker_implementation
tests.purpose: Inactive function metadata is traceable without a registered callable.
tests.rationale: Only a function spec is registered; ANY's active literal branch must match and inactive trace reports function identity/comparison=None. Failure to defer implementation lookup would prevent worker construction.

tests.name: test_spark_assignment_schema_rejects_incompatible_same_target_assignments
tests.purpose: Conflicting active assignment shapes fail schema construction.
tests.rationale: Public validator.assignment_schema sees string and struct assignments to one target and must raise with SPARK_ASSIGNMENT_TYPE_CONFLICT, directly covering production type resolution rather than deleted runtime convenience code.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_matched_rule_trace_includes_custom_function_args
tests.purpose: Matched custom-function audit includes authored and resolved arguments.
tests.rationale: Asserts function kind/name, source column, formatted argument values, result, exact explanation and a single actual callable invocation; keeps both observability and execution evidence.

tests.name: test_row_evaluator_binds_custom_function_metadata_once_per_ruleset
tests.purpose: Static function bindings are reused while mutable defaults stay row-local.
tests.rationale: Two public row evaluations require one bind, independent default-list contents and successful results; serialized worker restores and evaluates with emptied registry, so missing bound metadata would fail even though the driver's spy list does not observe mutations in a deserialized closure.

tests.name: test_trace_value_returns_common_scalars_without_json_serialization
tests.purpose: Common scalar trace values avoid JSON encoding.
tests.rationale: JSON alias is replaced with a failing spy and exact primitive outputs are required for None/string/int/float/bool; appropriate cheap hot-path regression using the actual fallback function.

tests.name: test_trace_value_handles_recursive_collections
tests.purpose: Circular runtime collections are rendered into safe audit metadata.
tests.rationale: Self-containing list must produce ['<recursive>'] through the production trace converter; protects a dynamic-only edge unavailable to valid authored literal codec input.

tests.name: test_trace_value_preserves_runtime_mapping_key_collisions
tests.purpose: Trace rendering does not silently collapse dynamic keys after stringification.
tests.rationale: Mixed 1/'1' keys must fall back to repr(value), preserving both entries; distinct from persistence's rejection/escaping of authored values.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_like_uses_sql_wildcard_semantics
tests.purpose: Percent wildcard matches appropriate strings in the worker.
tests.rationale: abc% matches abcde and rejects xyz, exactly meeting its narrower docstring's percent-wildcard purpose. It does not exhaust underscore, escaping or newline semantics.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_default_if_null_applies_to_custom_function_result_once
tests.purpose: Null-returning functions use fallback without reevaluation.
tests.rationale: Real callable counter, original/effective/default audit flags and successful UNKNOWN comparison require exactly one invocation and visible substitution.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_default_if_null_applies_to_assignment_operand
tests.purpose: Assignment null fallback is applied before typed output.
tests.rationale: Literal None with UNKNOWN fallback must yield exact applied typed string assignment; separates assignment resolution from traced condition fallback behavior.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_error_on_null_returns_compact_error
tests.purpose: Unresolved null produces a concise row error without traceback.
tests.rationale: Asserts ValueError prefix and absence of Traceback from direct worker evaluation. Here 'compact error' describes concise text, not compact payload mode; helper intentionally runs audit mode.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_can_include_debug_traceback
tests.purpose: Opt-in error payload includes traceback text.
tests.rationale: Same explicit null-error path enables include_error_traceback and requires Traceback text; meaningful flag toggle paired with default no-traceback coverage.

tests.name: test_spark_row_evaluator_can_raise_during_materializing_action
tests.purpose: Fail-fast errors are raised when Spark output is materialized.
tests.rationale: The body synchronously calls a Python worker closure and asserts RuntimeError; no DataFrame, Spark action or lazy execution is exercised. Keep as a worker fail-fast unit test with accurate name; live collect behavior already exists elsewhere.

tests.name: test_assignment_changed_compares_spark_normalized_values
tests.purpose: Date audit compares stored dates rather than original datetime classes.
tests.rationale: Assigning date(2025-01-15) over a same-day datetime requires changed=False; hits the DateType-specific audit normalization branch, distinct from timestamp decoder tests.

tests.name: test_spark_runtime_preflights_custom_function_serialization
tests.purpose: Serialization preflight turns unpicklable function state into a typed error.
tests.rationale: Deliberately unpicklable callable survives registry/build then validate_worker_serializable must raise ValidationFailedError with actionable worker guidance; direct method contract, not proof public plan invokes it.

tests.name: test_spark_runtime_accepts_serializable_worker_evaluator
tests.purpose: Valid worker closures pass serialization preflight.
tests.rationale: Builds a real simple closure and calls the production preflight without expecting an exception; a positive counterpart prevents blanket rejection from satisfying the negative test.

tests.name: test_full_precision_decimal_comparisons_ignore_ambient_context
tests.purpose: 38-digit decimals remain reflexively comparable under hostile decimal contexts.
tests.rationale: Six operators run public Python and worker paths inside precision=5, ROUND_UP and Inexact/Rounded traps with independent expected booleans; specific regressions in implicit decimal arithmetic would fail.

tests.name: test_decimal_tolerance_keeps_exact_boundary_digits
tests.purpose: Tolerance comparison retains digits beyond ambient precision.
tests.rationale: Three direct comparison calls at precision=3 distinguish an exact amount just beyond a 38-digit tolerance for EQ/GT/negative LT; focused arithmetic boundary cannot be inferred from reflexive comparison tests.

tests.name: test_custom_functions_cannot_mutate_authored_literal_collections
tests.purpose: Callable mutations cannot corrupt literal/fallback collections across rows or pickle.
tests.rationale: Four mode/fallback combinations invoke an appending function twice and after CloudPickle restoration, then assert caller and model literals unchanged; repeated reuse and source checks give real isolation evidence.

tests.name: test_prepared_rules_snapshot_stays_coherent_after_caller_mutation
tests.purpose: Prepared condition literals and cached function args remain a coherent snapshot.
tests.rationale: Mutates both authored list and argument map after preparation; old evaluator must keep original behavior while a new evaluator must see edits, proving meaningful before/after state isolation.

tests.name: test_assigned_collections_and_returned_results_do_not_alias_prepared_literals
tests.purpose: Indirect assigned arguments and returned collections retain independent snapshots.
tests.rationale: Mutating consumer and caller execute across repeated Python rows; exact seed/copy/last outputs, sibling independence and original/prepared literals are asserted, followed by repeated workers in both audit modes.

tests.name: test_worker_closure_excludes_inactive_rule_metadata
tests.purpose: Executor payload excludes retired rule history without losing live execution.
tests.rationale: 200 heavy inactive rules must leave no unique marker in serialized bytes, stay within 1.5x a live-only closure and still execute after unpickle; checks the actual regression and semantic preservation in both modes.

tests.name: test_binary_arguments_and_assignments_are_isolated_from_cached_results
tests.purpose: Binary mutations cannot alias cache, input rows, commits or sibling results.
tests.rationale: Cached bytearray plus mutating retained function args, returned seed mutation and two rows must preserve copy/input/cache in Python, compact and audit paths; tests bytearray-specific mutability missed by list-only coverage.

tests.name: test_serializer_persists_canonical_payload_with_explicit_fields
tests.purpose: Persist explicit operand fallbacks, tolerance and null-error metadata.
tests.rationale: Parses payload_json independently and checks the exact field/default mapping, string tolerance and true error flag. This catches paired encoder/decoder omissions that a round trip could miss.

tests.name: test_serializer_stamps_provenance_hash_and_summary_counts
tests.purpose: Populate lifecycle/provenance metadata, integrity hash and queryable summary counts.
tests.rationale: Owner fields are asserted, but no nondefault publication provenance is supplied, lifecycle status is not asserted, and all three tested summary counts are one. Constant counts and wrong lifecycle survive.

tests.name: test_serializer_counts_nested_custom_function_operands
tests.purpose: Count nested custom functions rather than only top-level function operands.
tests.rationale: An inner function sits in a list argument of an outer function and custom_function_count must equal two, reaching shared recursive traversal rather than only the rule root.

tests.name: test_content_hash_equals_sha256_of_payload_json
tests.purpose: Make persisted integrity hashes independently reproducible from UTF-8 payload bytes.
tests.rationale: Uses hashlib directly against stored payload_json and compares to row.content_hash. The independent standard-library oracle is necessary despite other same-serializer hash comparisons.

tests.name: test_content_hash_and_payload_json_are_deterministic
tests.purpose: Keep canonical serialization stable across dictionary ordering and repeat calls.
tests.rationale: Serializing the same unchanged object twice checks repeatability only. It never varies insertion order, and a serializer that stops sorting mapping keys still passes.

tests.name: test_deserializer_reconstructs_canonical_models
tests.purpose: Reconstruct a minimal persisted model exactly.
tests.rationale: Complete dataclass equality protects the basic public round-trip contract. Richer round trips overlap this smoke case, but it is small, diagnostic and not obsolete.

tests.name: test_serializer_round_trips_exact_decimal_scalars_and_collections
tests.purpose: Keep persisted Decimal values numeric, precise and kind-preserving.
tests.rationale: Independent parse_float=Decimal inspection checks numeric tokens, large precision, an integral Decimal exponent, model reconstruction and re-hash equality; avoids a serializer-only oracle.

tests.name: test_malformed_extended_json_envelopes_fail_uniformly
tests.purpose: Reject malformed date/datetime/tuple/set/mapping envelopes with domain errors.
tests.rationale: Six malformed cases include unhashable decoded set members and require ValueError naming the type. Direct canonical decoder boundary complements RepositoryError wrapping tests.

tests.name: test_canonical_json_rejects_nonfinite_float
tests.purpose: Prevent nonstandard infinite numeric values in canonical JSON.
tests.rationale: The positive-infinity case reaches canonical_json_dumps directly and requires a finite-value ValueError; compile-time nonfinite tests cannot replace this encoder guard.

tests.name: test_canonical_json_rejects_keys_that_normalize_to_the_same_string
tests.purpose: Prevent duplicate JSON keys after string normalization.
tests.rationale: Direct encoder call with integer/string 1 verifies key-collision rejection independently of compiler checks. Intentional boundary layering rather than duplicate execution.

tests.name: test_serializer_round_trips_temporal_and_python_collection_literals
tests.purpose: Round-trip temporal literals, sets, tuples and reserved-envelope-shaped data.
tests.rationale: Places supported kinds in both raw function args and literal assignments, requiring full model and content-hash equality. Distinct from JSON-ready numeric graph and YAML export tests.

tests.name: test_persisted_payload_excludes_lifecycle_status
tests.purpose: Keep lifecycle status outside the canonical persisted content.
tests.rationale: Direct payload-key assertion guards separation of authored content and table lifecycle independently of model equality. The current model intentionally has no status member.

tests.name: test_service_runtime_reuses_injected_compatibility_validator
tests.purpose: Publish and runtime schema checks share the configured validator.
tests.rationale: Identity assertions prove publication and runtime reuse the injected validator. Private attributes are justified here by the constructor wiring contract.

tests.name: test_service_from_schema_uses_standard_table_names
tests.purpose: Builds a service from schema and checks repository table names.
tests.rationale: Exercises the facade factory and exact default table names. Complements the table-name value-object unit test rather than duplicating its entry point.

tests.name: test_service_from_schema_accepts_custom_table_names
tests.purpose: Builds a service from schema while overriding metadata table names.
tests.rationale: Both explicit table overrides must reach the public table_names property. Protects caller configuration propagation.

tests.name: test_service_publish_yaml_text_and_loads_published_ruleset
tests.purpose: Publishes YAML through the facade and loads it back.
tests.rationale: Compiles/publishes and preserves actor/name, but the fake loader ignores version. Silently dropping the pinned version survives; record and assert the exact load arguments.

tests.name: test_service_create_tables_save_standard_functions_and_retire
tests.purpose: Exercises table creation, standard function registry save, and retire facade calls.
tests.rationale: Records table mode, standard registry presence/default update policy and retirement identity/actor. Broad facade smoke test, but each operation has an observable assertion.

tests.name: test_service_saves_supplied_function_registry_rows
tests.purpose: Saves caller-supplied function registry rows through the facade.
tests.rationale: Checks exact supplied rows and default update flag pass through the custom-registry facade. Different contract from generating standard rows.

tests.name: test_service_can_preserve_standard_function_registry_when_requested
tests.purpose: Allows callers to preserve existing standard registry rows explicitly.
tests.rationale: Asserts False propagates to repository update_existing, complementing default-upsert coverage.

tests.name: test_service_evaluate_dataframe_requires_ruleset_or_name
tests.purpose: Rejects evaluate calls without a ruleset or ruleset name.
tests.rationale: Public evaluation without supplied metadata or a name raises the expected resolution error before runtime use.

tests.name: test_service_passes_runtime_error_options_through
tests.purpose: Evaluation options reach the runtime unchanged with the supplied ruleset.
tests.rationale: Captures the complete option dictionary, supplied ruleset identity and returned sentinel. Strong unit test of facade delegation; no Spark worker is needed.

tests.name: test_service_passes_omitted_key_columns_through_as_none
tests.purpose: The runtime owns expansion of omitted keys from the actual DataFrame schema.
tests.rationale: Omitted keys must remain None at the facade boundary, allowing the runtime to expand actual source columns. Distinct from the live expansion test.

tests.name: test_service_describe_rules_formats_supplied_ruleset
tests.purpose: Formats compiled rule metadata into readable table-shaped rows.
tests.rationale: Compares exact table-shaped IDs, quoted predicate and assignment expression against a hand-written expected record.

tests.name: test_service_describe_rules_loads_published_ruleset_and_formats_nested_logic
tests.purpose: Loads a published ruleset and renders nested condition groups.
tests.rationale: Exact nested Boolean formatting and name lookup are protected, but the recording repository discards version. Add exact load-argument assertions while retaining this formatting scenario.

tests.name: test_service_describe_rules_requires_ruleset_or_name
tests.purpose: Rejects describe calls without a ruleset or ruleset name.
tests.rationale: Exercises the separate describe entry point with missing metadata and requires the resolution error. Cheap deliberate facade-boundary overlap.

tests.name: test_service_publish_accepts_compiled_ruleset
tests.purpose: Publishes an already compiled ruleset through the facade.
tests.rationale: An already compiled model reaches repository persistence through service.publish. A separate public entry point from publish_yaml_text, although content/actor assertions could be more complete.

tests.name: test_timestamp_field_compares_with_offset_literal_after_python_codec_decode
tests.purpose: Decoded TimestampType values retain their instant against offset literals.
tests.rationale: Uses actual Python TimestampType encode/decode, confirms decoder output is naive, then checks EQ/GE/IN/BETWEEN matches and aware UTC copied output; toInternal smoke check is explicitly a Python codec proxy, not JVM evidence.

tests.name: test_timestamp_normalization_recurses_and_preserves_ntz
tests.purpose: Nested timestamps normalize to UTC while NTZ wall-clock values stay naive.
tests.rationale: Struct containing array/map timestamps and NTZ field must equal exact nested expected values, retain NTZ tzinfo=None and pass Python output codec conversion; covers recursive branches missed by scalar instant test.

tests.name: test_full_audit_does_not_revalidate_original_nonfinite_value
tests.purpose: Auditing an existing nonfinite value does not block a valid overwrite.
tests.rationale: NaN/positive/negative infinity source values receive valid assignment; audit must match compact fields, return no error and changed=True, then encode safely. Distinguishes old evidence from new-value validation.

tests.name: test_bad_custom_returns_are_captured_before_spark_output_conversion
tests.purpose: Invalid dynamic returns become safe error rows or fail-fast errors.
tests.rationale: Fifteen schemas/value shapes pass real preflight with any hint, then require error, unmatched, unapplied/null and codec-safe payload; strict workers must raise. Error contents are separately pinned for precision/float cases.

tests.name: test_prepared_spark_schema_validates_and_resolves_assignment_types_once
tests.purpose: Prepared schema performs one base validation and one type resolution.
tests.rationale: Spies both actual collaborators on a source-field assignment, asserts exact counts plus passed validation, source projection and inferred LongType; accurately scopes the claim to validator.prepare rather than complete public planning.

tests.name: test_float32_overflow_reports_the_assignment_value_and_target_type
tests.purpose: Float32 overflow reports the offending value and target type.
tests.rationale: Both overflow signs in both audit modes require the exact OverflowError domain message, unapplied/null target and codec-safe error output; direct regression for leaked struct.pack errors.

tests.name: test_float32_rounding_is_visible_to_later_rules
tests.purpose: Downstream rules observe float32-rounded committed values.
tests.rationale: Final target and copied values plus target.hex() prove output rounding, but copied inherits FloatType and is independently narrowed. All six cases pass with downstream AssignedOperand reads forcibly returning the original double, so a condition/function must observe the read before recasting.

tests.name: test_naive_literal_infers_ntz_and_rejects_timestamp_field_comparison
tests.purpose: Naive literals work with NTZ and reject instant comparisons at preflight.
tests.rationale: Valid NTZ worker matches and copies wall-clock value; swapping source to TimestampType must yield SPARK_CONDITION_TEMPORAL_MISMATCH. Schema inference is implicit in successful _worker preparation, so an explicit inferred-type assertion would be clearer but current execution constrains it.

tests.name: test_naive_literal_without_ntz_support_has_actionable_preflight_issue
tests.purpose: Missing NTZ capability yields useful authoring guidance.
tests.rationale: Temporarily sets production capability constant to None and requires the precise unavailable issue with both timestamp_ntz and UTC-offset guidance; compatibility fallback exists in current code/documentation even though supported CI runtimes provide NTZ.

tests.name: test_struct_map_keys_stay_hashable_after_recursive_timestamp_normalization
tests.purpose: Composite struct map keys remain hashable after timestamp normalization.
tests.rationale: Source Row keys include decoded instant and nested Row; output must equal a hashable Row-keyed expected map, preserve named-field access and pass toInternal. This exercises key rebuilding beyond simple map values.

tests.name: test_composite_map_output_keys_remain_hashable_and_spark_convertible
tests.purpose: Array, binary and struct map keys retain hashability and Python codec support.
tests.rationale: Three key types require exact output map equality and successful toInternal; valid complement to struct/timestamp key test because separate array/binary key branches run, with no live-JVM claim from this module.

tests.name: test_public_boolean_options_reject_truthy_non_booleans_before_plan_access
tests.purpose: Public boolean flags reject non-booleans before attached-plan access.
tests.rationale: Three options times three invalid values call evaluate_attached_dataframe with df=None and require option-specific TypeError, so accidental frame access cannot satisfy the assertion. Title says truthy but 0/None are falsey; all are properly rejected non-bools.

tests.name: test_assignment_audit_captures_values_before_later_custom_code_mutates_them
tests.purpose: Historical audit values/changed decisions are frozen before later mutations.
tests.rationale: Second rule mutates original and cached bytearrays, mutation is positively asserted, while first event must retain old/proposed 'A' and changed=False; strong time-of-capture evidence rather than container-identity assumptions.

tests.name: test_spark_runtime_evaluates_row_rule
tests.purpose: Evaluates a row-level rule through Spark DataFrame runtime.
tests.rationale: Real workers verify matched/unmatched outcomes, schema nullability, applied business rows, two-rule overrides and provenance. Large combined smoke case is valuable; optional splitting improves diagnosis, not deletion.

tests.name: test_dataframe_evaluation_separates_results_and_applies_atomic_values
tests.purpose: Keyed results stay separate while scalar, null, and struct values apply atomically.
tests.rationale: Real clear/replace/keep rows distinguish no assignment from assign-null and assert whole-struct replacement, key/result separation, values and column order.

tests.name: test_dataframe_evaluation_persists_one_shared_plan
tests.purpose: Explicit persistence is owned by the internal source-plus-results plan.
tests.rationale: Checks persist/unpersist fluent API and storage state on the owned plan. Complements the accumulator test, which proves reuse but not these return/storage contracts.

tests.name: test_dataframe_evaluation_defaults_keys_to_every_input_column
tests.purpose: Omitted keys keep the complete source record in the result projection.
tests.rationale: Calls the runtime directly without helper defaults and checks all input columns become keys in order. Correctly avoids the helper that would fill explicit keys.

tests.name: test_persisted_projections_evaluate_custom_assignment_once_per_row
tests.purpose: Both public projections reuse one cached worker evaluation.
tests.rationale: A real worker accumulator observes exactly three calls after materializing both cached projections. Distinct execution-reuse evidence; appropriately gated off unsupported serverless APIs.

tests.name: test_spark_runtime_applies_typed_operand_defaults_before_comparison
tests.purpose: Numeric and string fallbacks are applied before the real Spark UDF compares.
tests.rationale: Null numeric/string inputs must match real-worker rules and emit independent original/default/applied trace facts. Exercises typed UDF fallback integration.

tests.name: test_spark_runtime_quarantines_error_on_null
tests.purpose: A remaining null becomes a compact row error when explicitly required.
tests.rationale: Docstring claims compact errors, but full_audit=True exercises audit mode only. Preserve it and parameterize both modes or describe the narrower audit purpose.

tests.name: test_spark_runtime_builds_one_python_udf
tests.purpose: The runtime creates one UDF whose result struct feeds every output field.
tests.rationale: Spies on the actual UDF factory, asserts one call and useArrow=False, then materializes a match. This protects construction architecture; it is not a once-per-row invocation test.

tests.name: test_spark_runtime_evaluates_and_assigns_standard_date_functions
tests.purpose: Date arithmetic remains typed through the real Spark UDF boundary.
tests.rationale: Real date_add_months predicate and date_add_years assignment verify a leap-month boundary, exact date and Spark DateType.

tests.name: test_spark_runtime_executes_nested_array_and_optional_standard_arguments
tests.purpose: Recursive arguments and optional defaults survive the real worker boundary.
tests.rationale: Real worker output checks coalesce field recursion, omitted substring length, all-tags predicate and ordered joining. Complements pure standard-function tests at serialization.

tests.name: test_spark_runtime_serializes_only_required_literal_source_columns
tests.purpose: Evaluates a dotted source field while retaining an unrelated input column.
tests.rationale: Checks helper dependencies and final values but not the actual UDF input struct. An in-memory mutation sending every source column passes unchanged.

tests.name: test_spark_runtime_evaluates_literal_only_rule_without_source_dependencies
tests.purpose: Evaluates a literal-only rule with an empty dependency set.
tests.rationale: Checks an empty helper dependency list and successful results, but sending all source columns also passes, so it does not prove the empty-struct branch was exercised.

tests.name: test_spark_runtime_carries_assigned_values_across_real_worker_boundary
tests.purpose: Committed assignment state and provenance survive Spark UDF serialization.
tests.rationale: Real worker serialization preserves a producer-to-consumer assigned value and independently checks producing rule/assignment provenance.

tests.name: test_spark_runtime_applies_column_prefix_to_all_new_outputs
tests.purpose: Custom prefixes preserve exact compact and full-audit column contracts.
tests.rationale: Exact ordered compact and audit schemas are asserted under a custom prefix. Schema-only by purpose; worker collection would add little.

tests.name: test_spark_runtime_validates_schema_before_building_udf
tests.purpose: An incompatible existing target fails before row evaluation.
tests.rationale: Asserts a construction-time schema error, but no spy proves the UDF was not constructed first. Add a fail-if-called UDF/builder spy or narrow the title.

tests.name: test_spark_runtime_rejects_a_ruleset_with_no_active_rules
tests.purpose: Evaluation cannot expose an unwritable zero-field assignment struct.
tests.rationale: The public Spark entry point rejects an all-inactive ruleset before exposing an empty assignment struct. Useful adapter gate despite base-validator overlap.

tests.name: test_spark_runtime_preserves_mapping_literal_assignment_as_struct
tests.purpose: Emits mapping literal assignments as nested Spark structs.
tests.rationale: Asserts nested Boolean StructType fields and actual result/business values after collection. Distinct real-worker evidence for new mapping targets.

tests.name: test_spark_runtime_preserves_decimal_and_array_assignments
tests.purpose: Financial values stay exact across the real Python UDF boundary.
tests.rationale: Existing decimal target, parsed financial text and Decimal array are compared with independent exact expected values after real serialization and assignment application.

tests.name: test_spark_runtime_quarantines_errors_without_failing_job
tests.purpose: Production quarantine mode retains good rows and marks bad rows.
