tests.rationale: Good and failing custom-function rows verify quarantine, original/new target preservation, default traceback omission, plus a real failing collect in fail-fast mode.

tests.name: test_fail_on_error_remains_lazy_until_callers_action
tests.purpose: Building output does not hide a separate full-data validation action.
tests.rationale: Spark job-group tracker proves construction and both projections launch no job; materialization then creates a job and returns the expected match.

tests.name: test_spark_runtime_preserves_timestamp_assignment_type
tests.purpose: Timestamp assignment values survive the real worker serialization path.
tests.rationale: Real TimestampType input copies through both projections with expected wall-clock values. Add an explicit output type assertion for the title, but keep its live timestamp boundary coverage.

tests.name: test_spark_runtime_preserves_timestamp_ntz_assignment_type
tests.purpose: TimestampNTZ survives schema inference and live worker serialization.
tests.rationale: Uses an explicit NTZ schema, asserts returned nested NTZ type and expected naive datetime after collection. Distinct from instant semantics.

tests.name: test_full_audit_emits_ordered_optional_detail_and_identity
tests.purpose: The default stays compact while full audit adds ordered diagnostics.
tests.rationale: Checks exact compact/audit column order, compact identity/hash fields, driver manifest, audit-inline manifest and business projection separation. Engine version is only truthy, a small untested exact-identity detail.

tests.name: test_coverage_report_finds_dead_broad_and_clean_no_match_rows
tests.purpose: Coverage aggregates matches and returns clean no-match rows.
tests.rationale: Protects totals, dead/broad IDs and one no-match row, but no error input or first-match assertions exist. Losing error exclusion or forcing first counts to zero survives.

tests.name: test_timestamp_literal_compares_with_real_worker_timestamp
tests.purpose: Offset-authored literals compare by instant under differing Spark session zones.
tests.rationale: Four cases compare an offset literal with real decoded instant data under two Spark session zones and both audit modes; both returned and applied values match the input instant.

tests.name: test_full_audit_overwrites_nonfinite_source_without_changing_results
tests.purpose: full audit overwrites nonfinite source without changing results
tests.rationale: NaN and both infinities are overwritten with an independent 1.0 expectation, while compact/full outcomes must agree. Shared-oracle risk is reduced by the explicit final-value check.

tests.name: test_bad_timestamp_result_is_an_error_row_with_recorded_function_contract
tests.purpose: bad timestamp result is an error row with recorded function contract
tests.rationale: A wrongly typed custom return becomes a quarantined real-worker error with unapplied target; manifest fields and row hash are independently verified.

tests.name: test_struct_map_key_field_copy_preserves_nested_timestamps
tests.purpose: struct map key field copy preserves nested timestamps
tests.rationale: Real struct-valued map keys with nested instant/struct fields must survive assignment unchanged relative to the decoded source. Covers a specialized JVM/Python boundary.

tests.name: test_function_identity_distinguishes_observable_default_collection_kinds
tests.purpose: Default kinds that change callable behavior must change the execution identity.
tests.rationale: Same ruleset with list/tuple registry defaults must produce distinct behavior and function hashes while keeping ruleset hash equal; exact manifest envelopes are checked.

tests.name: test_large_function_manifest_is_retained_once_for_compact_results
tests.purpose: Compact and attached rows carry a verifiable hash; full audit includes the manifest.
tests.rationale: Ten dependencies, two compact rows, attached schema, full-audit payload and later registry-default mutation verify driver snapshot/hash and compact-width contracts. Genuine new integration coverage.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_allows_error_on_null_for_udf_row_path
tests.purpose: Allow error_on_null on Spark row-runtime conditions.
tests.rationale: Calls validate(ruleset) without schema, which delegates directly to base validation. A prepare() trap is never triggered; the Spark compatibility acceptance claimed by the test remains untested.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_rejects_incompatible_operand_default
tests.purpose: Reject numeric defaults on string operands.
tests.rationale: A StringType status field with integer fallback must emit SPARK_DEFAULT_IF_NULL_TYPE_INCOMPATIBLE; exercises schema-specific fallback compatibility.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_allows_numeric_operand_default
tests.purpose: Allow integer defaults on double operands.
tests.rationale: Uses a DoubleType field, integer zero fallback and typed double comparison; only excludes one issue ID. Injecting another error leaves the test green; assert result.passed.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_rejects_missing_condition_field
tests.purpose: Reject missing condition source columns.
tests.rationale: An empty StructType lacks status; requires the condition-specific missing-field diagnostic rather than relying on eventual Spark execution.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_rejects_missing_assignment_source_field
tests.purpose: Reject missing assignment source columns.
tests.rationale: Schema includes condition field status but omits missing_source; requires the assignment-specific missing-field diagnostic.

tests.name: test_schema_diagnostics_are_retained_with_ordinary_base_issues
tests.purpose: Keep independent schema diagnostics alongside ordinary base issues.
tests.rationale: Combines missing owner with a missing condition column and requires both diagnostics; detects incorrectly treating all base issues as schema traversal blockers.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_rejects_ambiguous_referenced_source_fields
tests.purpose: Reject duplicated source fields referenced in conditions and assignments.
tests.rationale: Schema has exact duplicates for both referenced names; assertion requires both contextual ambiguity diagnostic IDs.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_rejects_ambiguous_existing_assignment_target
tests.purpose: Reject an ambiguous existing assignment target.
tests.rationale: Two target fields in source schema and one assignment must emit SPARK_ASSIGNMENT_TARGET_AMBIGUOUS; target resolution is distinct from source-reference validation.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_rejects_multiple_case_variant_assignment_targets
tests.purpose: Reject multiple case variants matching an assignment target.
tests.rationale: Source Target and TARGET both match authored target by casefold; requires target ambiguity despite no exact spelling match.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_rejects_case_insensitive_assignment_source_collision
tests.purpose: Reject new assignment target names colliding by case with one source column.
tests.rationale: Source Score versus assigned score must emit the case-collision issue and assignment_schema must raise containing that diagnostic; checks both reported and enforced failure.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_rejects_casefold_colliding_new_assignment_targets
tests.purpose: Reject casefold-colliding new targets across active rules.
tests.rationale: Two active rules assign Score and score with no existing target; validation and assignment_schema rejection exercise the cross-rule collision branch.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_allows_same_exact_target_across_rules
tests.purpose: Allow ordered rules to reuse one exactly spelled assignment target.
tests.rationale: Two rules assign score; checks no collision and the public assignment_schema succeeds with exactly one score field. Schema success entails all validation passed.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_rejects_incompatible_existing_target_type
tests.purpose: Reject incompatible assignment types for an existing target.
tests.rationale: An integer literal assigned to an existing string target requires SPARK_ASSIGNMENT_TARGET_TYPE_INCOMPATIBLE; detects unsafe implicit stringification.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_rejects_incompatible_new_target_assignments
tests.purpose: Reject irreconcilable assignment types for a new target.
tests.rationale: Different rules assign text and integer to a new target; requires SPARK_ASSIGNMENT_TYPE_CONFLICT from type unification rather than existing-target validation.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_infers_new_target_type_from_prior_assignment
tests.purpose: Infer new assignment types from earlier assigned values.
tests.rationale: A score literal producer and copied_score consumer must pass, and both public schema fields must be LongType. Confirms propagation instead of unresolved or string fallback.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_keeps_existing_target_type_for_assigned_references
tests.purpose: Use an existing target type for downstream assigned references.
tests.rationale: Long-inferred literal 5 is pinned to existing IntegerType score before a second assigned score write. Both successful validation and IntegerType schema catch widening of the producer type.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_existing_target_supplies_null_literal_type
tests.purpose: Use an existing target type for an untyped null literal.
tests.rationale: Null assigned to existing LongType target must pass and retain LongType in assignment_schema; guards legitimate null updates.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_new_null_literal_requires_value_type
tests.purpose: Require a type hint for null assigned to a new target.
tests.rationale: Null with no existing target must emit SPARK_ASSIGNMENT_NULL_TYPE_REQUIRED; distinguishes unknown output type from the preceding valid update case.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_new_field_operand_inherits_source_type
tests.purpose: Inherit an assignment source field type for a new target.
tests.rationale: A DateType source operand must validate and yield DateType output, covering field-based inference independently of literals and assigned operands.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_new_custom_assignment_requires_return_type_hint
tests.purpose: Require a return type for a custom function creating a new target.
tests.rationale: Registers a valid assignment function with return_type_hint=None and checks SPARK_ASSIGNMENT_RETURN_TYPE_REQUIRED; covers the missing-hint branch.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_polymorphic_assignment_uses_existing_target_type
tests.purpose: Allow an any-returning function to update an existing typed target.
tests.rationale: Registers an any function whose argument is a source field and asserts the entire validation passes for an existing StringType target. Row value enforcement belongs to runtime tests.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_polymorphic_assignment_requires_new_target_type
tests.purpose: Require an explicit type for a polymorphic function creating a new target.
tests.rationale: Uses explicit any return hint and asserts REQUIRED appears while UNSUPPORTED does not. Distinct from absent hint because any is valid registry metadata.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_does_not_guess_condition_coercion_semantics
tests.purpose: Keep supported cross-type numeric coercion out of schema rejection.
tests.rationale: Both amount and the right literal are strings. A mutant rejecting every unequal pair of inferred types still passes this test; use StringType versus integer/decimal literal and the reverse direction.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_unifies_decimal_literals_without_float_fallback
tests.purpose: Unify decimal literals without losing scale or falling back to float.
tests.rationale: Two literals require three integer digits and four fractional digits; validates and asserts exact DecimalType(7,4), strongly constraining the merge.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_rejects_lossy_decimal_scale_narrowing
tests.purpose: Reject dynamic decimal scale narrowing.
tests.rationale: A DecimalType(18,4) field cannot fit DecimalType(18,2) without possible rounding; checks incompatible-target issue using a dynamic field rather than one fitting literal.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_accepts_safe_decimal_widening
tests.purpose: Accept safe dynamic decimal widening.
tests.rationale: A DecimalType(10,2) source is assigned to DecimalType(14,4); asserts full validation success, complementing narrowing rejection.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_accepts_yaml_fraction_for_existing_decimal_target
tests.purpose: Accept exact authored fractions in existing decimal targets and reject nonfitting decimals.
tests.rationale: Checks two valid rulesets plus positive/negative decimal_value_fits cases, including trailing-zero removal and negative scale. Combines a useful integration example with the low-level boundary oracle; no obsolete path.

tests.name: test_compiled_literals_honor_every_fixed_spark_type_hint
tests.purpose: Compile every fixed Spark type hint to a compatible worker Python value.
tests.rationale: The representative map must equal the full SPARK_TYPE_HINTS key set; each compiled value is checked against inferred type, Decimal fit or naive datetime shape. Uses a current helper intentionally for the compiler/type-table invariant.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_infers_decimal_for_new_yaml_fraction_target
tests.purpose: Infer decimal rather than binary floating output for an untyped YAML fraction.
tests.rationale: Fraction 0.0425 validates and produces DecimalType(4,4) for a new target; distinct from fitting an existing target.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_accepts_to_decimal_for_existing_decimal_target
tests.purpose: Accept decimal-returning conversion into an existing decimal target.
tests.rationale: Registered to_decimal has generic decimal return precision but existing DecimalType(18,6) is accepted; protects data-dependent runtime fit enforcement.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_infers_decimal_for_new_to_decimal_target
tests.purpose: Infer the fixed decimal output contract for a new to_decimal target.
tests.rationale: The same registered converter creating parsed must validate and yield DecimalType(38,18); covers new-target inference rather than existing-target compatibility.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_rejects_scalar_field_for_array_argument
tests.purpose: Reject scalar fields used as array arguments.
tests.rationale: array_size receives a StringType source through FieldOperand; requires SPARK_CUSTOM_FUNCTION_ARG_TYPE_INCOMPATIBLE, which base literal-shape validation cannot determine.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_resolves_same_as_argument_return_type
tests.purpose: Resolve same_as argument-derived return hints.
tests.rationale: null_if(value=source_value) with IntegerType source must yield IntegerType cleaned and pass validation; verifies argument-dependent return inference.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_rejects_incompatible_coalesce_item_types
tests.purpose: Reject incompatible common_type function arguments.
tests.rationale: coalesce receives nested StringType and IntegerType fields; requires SPARK_CUSTOM_FUNCTION_COMMON_TYPE_CONFLICT from mixed sequence inference.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_rejects_date_compared_with_quoted_string
tests.purpose: Reject date versus untyped quoted string comparisons.
tests.rationale: DateType as_of_date compared to string ISO date must emit the temporal mismatch; ensures date-looking text is not silently treated as a date.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_rejects_temporal_tolerance
tests.purpose: Reject nonzero tolerance on known temporal scalar and collection comparisons.
tests.rationale: Parametrizes date ge scalar and date in collection, requiring the Spark temporal-tolerance issue for both shapes.

tests.name: test_temporal_between_tolerance_uses_the_base_operator_diagnostic_once
tests.purpose: Report between tolerance failure once through base validation.
tests.rationale: Counts exactly one BETWEEN_TOLERANCE_FORBIDDEN and excludes duplicate Spark temporal-tolerance reporting; tests diagnostic composition rather than acceptance.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_rejects_scalar_string_membership_field
tests.purpose: Reject scalar string fields on the right side of membership.
tests.rationale: An in condition reads flags_string as StringType and must emit the membership collection diagnostic; covers schema-known field operands unavailable to base validation.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_allows_array_membership_field
tests.purpose: Allow array fields on the right side of membership.
tests.rationale: Provides ArrayType(StringType) but only asserts absence of the membership-specific diagnostic. Another validation failure is ignored; add full success assertion.

tests.name: test_mapping_literal_schema_order_is_stable_after_persistence
tests.purpose: Keep mapping literal schema order stable through persistence.
tests.rationale: A deliberately reverse-alphabetical mapping is serialized and deserialized; direct field names must be sorted and reloaded StructType exactly equal, preventing positional schema drift.

tests.name: test_mapping_literal_matches_existing_nested_struct_by_field_name
tests.purpose: Match nested mapping literals to existing struct fields by name.
tests.rationale: Literal and target orders differ at multiple nesting levels; validation must pass and assignment_type must equal the existing target including order and nullability.

tests.name: test_mapping_literal_rejects_struct_shape_and_nested_type_conflicts
tests.purpose: Reject missing, extra, mistyped and forbidden-null nested struct fields.
tests.rationale: Five distinct malformed mappings require incompatible-target diagnostics; checks both outer field shape and nested type/nullability. Each is an independent production branch.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_reports_unsupported_typed_null_precisely
tests.purpose: Report an unsupported typed null distinctly from a missing hint.
tests.rationale: An allowed-to-compile uuid hint on null must emit VALUE_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED and exclude NULL_TYPE_REQUIRED; preserves actionable diagnostic specificity.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_quarantines_malformed_direct_value_type_metadata
tests.purpose: Quarantine malformed direct-model hints before unsafe Spark schema traversal.
tests.rationale: Replaces value_type with a list, then checks base diagnostic and public assignment_schema failure containing it. Exercises the schema-blocker boundary beyond base validation alone.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_rejects_untyped_nulltype_assignment_source
tests.purpose: Reject unresolved assignment types from NullType fields.
tests.rationale: A present null_source field has NullType; requires TYPE_UNRESOLVED rather than missing-field or null-literal diagnostics.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_rejects_timestamp_representation_assignment_change
tests.purpose: Reject changing timestamp representations in assignments.
tests.rationale: A TimestampNTZType source assigned to TimestampType target must fail compatibility, testing type distinction independent of Python datetime normalization.

tests.name: test_spark_validator_rejects_timestamp_representation_condition_change
tests.purpose: Reject comparison between instant and wall-clock timestamp fields.
tests.rationale: TimestampType and TimestampNTZType fields in ge must emit temporal mismatch; complements assignment-specific rejection.

tests.name: test_naive_timestamp_literal_mismatch_explains_ntz_representation
tests.purpose: Explain naive datetime mismatch with an instant column using NTZ terminology.
tests.rationale: Locates the required temporal mismatch and asserts timestamp_ntz in its message; a focused diagnostic wording contract, not intended as acceptance coverage.

tests.name: test_timestamp_ntz_literal_hint_matches_ntz_field
tests.purpose: Accept an explicit NTZ literal against an NTZ field.
tests.rationale: Naive datetime with NTZ hint only excludes temporal mismatch; a different false rejection still passes. Assert the overall valid result.

tests.name: test_timestamp_ntz_collection_hint_matches_ntz_field
tests.purpose: Accept an explicit NTZ collection hint against an NTZ field.
tests.rationale: One-element datetime collection exercises the array hint path, but only excludes temporal mismatch. Keep this shape and assert overall success.

tests.name: test_mixed_temporal_between_bounds_fail_preflight
tests.purpose: Reject mixed date/timestamp between bounds.
tests.rationale: A date and naive datetime pair has no safe common literal type; requires temporal mismatch, catching bypass through unresolved collection typing.

tests.name: test_substring_uses_sql_style_start_position
tests.purpose: Use a SQL-style 1-based substring start.
tests.rationale: substring("ABCDE",2,3) must equal BCD, directly distinguishing zero-based slicing. Worker field-argument tests layer binding/serialization rather than make this direct function test redundant.

tests.name: test_to_date_accepts_iso_date_values_and_propagates_nulls
tests.purpose: Parse ISO dates and propagate blank/null values.
tests.rationale: Checks whitespace trimming, datetime and date inputs, blank string and None, with concrete date outputs and identity None assertions.

tests.name: test_to_date_uses_aware_timestamp_own_calendar_date
tests.purpose: Use an aware timestamp own local calendar date for to_date.
tests.rationale: A +14:00 timestamp on March 1 corresponds to February 29 UTC; requiring March 1 distinguishes local date extraction from UTC normalization.

tests.name: test_to_date_rejects_ambiguous_or_invalid_values
tests.purpose: Reject ambiguous date formats and non-date scalar inputs.
tests.rationale: US-style date, compact date string and numeric date each raise ValueError with the documented domain guidance; exercises format and type rejection.

tests.name: test_date_add_days_supports_positive_and_negative_offsets
tests.purpose: Support positive and negative day offsets and null propagation.
tests.rationale: Forward and backward transitions both land on leap day, and None returns None; verifies signed day arithmetic independently of month logic.

tests.name: test_date_add_days_reports_out_of_range_offsets
tests.purpose: Report date range overflow as an actionable domain error.
tests.rationale: Upper bound, lower bound and huge offset cases require ValueError identifying input date and offset; distinguishes wrapped arithmetic overflow from raw exceptions.

tests.name: test_date_add_months_clamps_to_target_month_end
tests.purpose: Clamp added months to the target month end.
tests.rationale: Four cases include leap/nonleap February, negative offset and year rollover; each exact date discriminates the calendar behavior.

tests.name: test_date_add_years_clamps_leap_day_and_rejects_fractional_offsets
tests.purpose: Clamp leap-day year offsets and reject fractional years.
tests.rationale: Checks forward nonleap clamp, negative leap-year preservation and a fractional-offset ValueError; distinct from month-only conversion.

tests.name: test_date_diff_and_month_boundaries_have_explicit_calendar_semantics
tests.purpose: Define signed day difference and month boundary semantics.
tests.rationale: Requires +29 and -29 for reversed dates, null propagation, February first day and leap-year month end.

tests.name: test_text_functions_cover_cleaning_parsing_padding_and_patterns
tests.purpose: Exercise common text cleaning, parsing, padding and matching operations.
tests.rationale: Contains direct expected-value assertions for text helpers plus selected null/no-match cases; these are current public function smoke contracts. Broader exhaustive edge matrices could improve coverage but no claim warrants deletion.

tests.name: test_null_composition_functions_preserve_value_types
tests.purpose: Preserve original Python values through null composition.
tests.rationale: Uses a mapping marker and identity assertions for null_if/coalesce, plus actual null outputs. The identity check is stronger than value equality and deliberately differs from runtime isolation copying.

tests.name: test_converters_are_strict_and_offer_an_explicit_null_failure_policy
tests.purpose: Keep converters strict with explicit null-on-error policies.
tests.rationale: Checks boolean/string/decimal/integer successful conversions, four null-on-error results, fractional integer rejection and invalid on_error on both valid/invalid input.

tests.name: test_timestamp_converters_distinguish_instant_and_wall_clock_values
tests.purpose: Distinguish aware instants from naive wall-clock timestamps.
tests.rationale: The instant output is compared by datetime equality, which accepts an unchanged +01:00 timezone. Shape rejection is covered, but canonical UTC representation is not; assert UTC offset or tzinfo explicitly.

tests.name: test_decimal_functions_use_decimal_arithmetic_and_explicit_rounding
tests.purpose: Use exact decimal arithmetic and explicit rounding/selection semantics.
tests.rationale: Arithmetic, rounding and error oracles are useful; min is tested only with left smaller and max only with right larger. Returning the respective argument without comparison survives. Add reverse/equal and clamp lower/interior cases.

tests.name: test_calendar_boundary_and_completed_period_functions_are_explicit
tests.purpose: Define completed calendar periods and calendar boundaries.
tests.rationale: Boundary dates and incomplete periods are covered, but both reversed month/year examples expect zero. Taking absolute values of all period results survives; include negative completed periods.

tests.name: test_business_month_boundaries_require_explicit_holiday_calendars
tests.purpose: Use explicit holiday and weekend calendars for business-month boundaries.
tests.rationale: Asserts both directions skip configured holidays/weekends, custom ISO weekend days alter result, and all seven weekend days raise. Tests the actual calendar dependency rather than implicit locale assumptions.

tests.name: test_array_functions_are_null_aware_and_reject_scalar_inputs
tests.purpose: Use null-aware array predicates and reject scalar inputs.
tests.rationale: Size, join and scalar rejection are exercised; array_contains_all only expects True, and predicates lack null-side assertions. A valid-input always-True contains_all mutant passes; add false and both-null-side cases.

tests.name: test_standard_functions_can_be_registered_for_runtime_field_args
tests.purpose: Use registered standard functions with runtime field arguments.
tests.rationale: Compiles, validates, serializes and runs a worker closure: serialized field operand survives, substring condition matches and left assignment equals AB. This is useful multi-module offline integration, distinct from direct substring semantics.

tests.name: test_optional_defaults_and_nested_argument_operands_work_end_to_end
tests.purpose: Carry defaults and nested argument operands through preparation and worker serialization.
tests.rationale: Asserts agreement of required-column implementations, inferred coalesce type, CloudPickle round trip and exact output for coalesce/defaulted substring/array predicate. Keep as offline component integration; not a live Spark claim.

tests.name: test_standard_date_functions_work_in_conditions_and_typed_assignments
tests.purpose: Use standard date functions in conditions, typed assignments and audit explanations.
tests.rationale: Asserts date and integer schemas, a matching condition, typed values, rendered explanation and both authored expressions; covers function binding plus audit rendering beyond direct calendar helper tests.

tests.name: test_decimal_functions_preserve_full_precision_in_altered_contexts
tests.purpose: Isolate decimal precision, rounding and traps from ambient context.
tests.rationale: Sets precision=3, ROUND_UP and Inexact/Rounded traps, then checks six wide exact arithmetic/rounding outputs. Strong independent numeric constants catch context leakage.

tests.name: test_division_keeps_requested_fractional_digits_after_a_wide_integer_part
tests.purpose: Preserve fractional division precision after a wide integer portion.
tests.rationale: Uses 1E100 / 3 and explicit 100-digit integer plus 18 fractional digits for both safe and strict division under precision=3; covers a different width hazard from ordinary altered-context arithmetic.

tests.name: test_dependency_manifest_preserves_observable_default_collection_kinds
tests.purpose: Preserve observable default collection kinds in execution manifests.
tests.rationale: List, tuple and set defaults must decode to their exact kinds, produce corresponding runtime type names and yield three distinct manifests/hashes; validates identity aligned to execution behavior.

tests.name: test_registry_rejects_nonstring_keys_before_metadata_normalization
tests.purpose: Reject nonstring keys in defaults and allowed values before metadata normalization.
tests.rationale: Three argument contracts cover direct mapping default, nested mapping default and allowed value mapping; constructor must raise the specific RegistryError.

tests.name: test_registry_string_key_defaults_are_consistent_in_runtime_and_persistence
tests.purpose: Keep accepted string-key defaults consistent in binding and persisted metadata.
tests.rationale: Uses canonical string key "1" with nested list and compares both bind_args output and row contract; a focused positive counterpart to mapping-key rejection.

tests.name: test_timestamp_utc_overflow_honors_conversion_error_policy
tests.purpose: Apply conversion error policy to UTC normalization overflow.
tests.rationale: Year-one and year-9999 offset strings require None under null policy and ValueError under strict policy; directly exercises astimezone overflow wrapping.

tests.name: test_order_sensitive_functions_reject_yaml_sets_before_and_after_persistence
tests.purpose: Reject unordered arguments to order-sensitive functions before and after persistence.
tests.rationale: Parametrizes coalesce, concat_ws and array_join with a YAML set, serializes/reloads it, then checks semantic rejection and runtime TypeError for both models. This is necessary layered protection against changed collection kind.

tests.name: test_dependency_manifest_includes_nested_references_and_is_detached
tests.purpose: Include active nested function dependencies and return detached metadata.
tests.rationale: Manifest must contain exactly coalesce and upper in order, exclude inactive lower/unreferenced functions, carry versions/reference, and withstand caller mutation of nested argument metadata.

tests.name: test_standard_function_rows_expose_registry_metadata
tests.purpose: Expose complete standard registry rows and selected stable contracts.
tests.rationale: Checks 58-row count, required and retired names, fixed/dynamic hints and the exact substring argument contract. This is a metadata inventory contract, distinct from executing helper functions.

tests.name: test_missing_owner_metadata_fails_validation
tests.purpose: Require owner and department metadata and render a concise failure summary.
tests.rationale: Checks both ownership issue IDs and the two-issue summary; exercises RulesetValidator ownership checks and ValidationResult.to_text. This is a semantic governance contract, distinct from YAML syntax checks.

tests.name: test_ruleset_requires_at_least_one_active_rule
tests.purpose: Require at least one active rule.
tests.rationale: Compiles one inactive rule and checks RULESET_ACTIVE_RULE_REQUIRED; directly distinguishes a nonempty retired ruleset from an executable ruleset.

tests.name: test_code_authored_rule_ids_must_be_non_empty_strings
tests.purpose: Reject malformed programmatic rule IDs without crashing.
tests.rationale: Replaces the compiled ID with None, blank, whitespace, numeric, and unhashable values and checks RULE_ID_INVALID; validates the direct-model boundary skipped by compiler-only tests.

tests.name: test_code_authored_assignment_ids_must_be_non_empty_strings
tests.purpose: Reject malformed programmatic assignment IDs.
tests.rationale: Replaces an assignment ID with five malformed shapes and checks ASSIGNMENT_ID_INVALID; protects final-winner identity independently of rule identity.

tests.name: test_code_authored_required_text_returns_issues_instead_of_crashing
tests.purpose: Return structured issues for malformed direct-model text fields.
tests.rationale: Nine replacements cover ruleset, rule, group, condition, target, field and assigned-reference text; each result must contain its specific diagnostic, so an exception or generic issue fails.

tests.name: test_code_authored_rule_order_returns_a_structured_issue
tests.purpose: Validate rule ordering before hashing or sorting.
tests.rationale: None, text, bool and list order values exercise the structural guard and each must emit RULE_ORDER_INVALID without throwing.

tests.name: test_code_authored_tolerance_must_be_a_finite_decimal
tests.purpose: Reject non-Decimal and nonfinite tolerance metadata.
tests.rationale: Six values include NaN, Infinity and ordinary int zero; requires TOLERANCE_INVALID, distinguishing metadata validity from subsequent comparison behavior.

tests.name: test_direct_mapping_key_collision_fails_validation
tests.purpose: Detect string-normalization collisions in direct literal mappings.
tests.rationale: Creates the 1 versus "1" collision after compilation and requires MAPPING_KEY_NORMALIZATION_COLLISION; directly covers programmatic bypass of compiler key validation.

tests.name: test_code_authored_literal_value_type_returns_a_structured_issue
tests.purpose: Reject malformed literal type-hint metadata without unsafe traversal.
tests.rationale: Replaces assignment metadata with numeric, list, empty and whitespace hints and requires LITERAL_VALUE_TYPE_INVALID. Spark quarantine tests cover the separate downstream traversal boundary.

tests.name: test_custom_function_args_mismatch_fails_validation
tests.purpose: Reject missing, extra or misspelled custom function arguments.
tests.rationale: The registry requires x and y but the fixture supplies only x, so missing arguments are checked. Silently discarding extra arguments survives this test; add an extra-only case and inspect the mismatch details.

tests.name: test_custom_function_optional_defaults_and_argument_constraints_are_validated
tests.purpose: Validate optional defaults, argument types, allowed values and literal-only constraints.
tests.rationale: Seven calls check omitted optional mode acceptance, numeric argument rejection, bad allowed value rejection, dynamic literal-only rejection, explicit literal acceptance and effective default_if_null behavior. Assertions distinguish all these registry/validator interactions.

tests.name: test_custom_function_registry_rejects_unenforceable_argument_metadata
tests.purpose: Reject unenforceable registry argument metadata at construction.
tests.rationale: Requires RegistryError for allowed_values without literal_only and an unencodable object default. Constructor invariants are current and distinct from authored-argument validation; placement in this module is harmless.

tests.name: test_error_on_null_is_rejected_for_unary_null_operators
tests.purpose: Reject error_on_null on unary null tests.
tests.rationale: An is_null condition with error_on_null=True must emit ERROR_ON_NULL_UNARY_FORBIDDEN; exercises the shared unary-operator contract with a representative member.

tests.name: test_assigned_operand_requires_an_active_lower_order_producer
tests.purpose: Require an active, strictly earlier producer for assigned references.
tests.rationale: Only a same-rule producer is constructed. Mutants allowing future producers or including inactive producers both pass; retain and expand to explicit future/inactive fixtures.

tests.name: test_assigned_operand_accepts_a_potential_prior_producer
tests.purpose: Accept a structurally earlier producer even if it might not match every row.
tests.rationale: Builds a conditional order-1 bucket producer and order-2 consumer but only checks absence of one diagnostic. Keep the valid fixture and assert result.passed so another erroneous rejection cannot pass.

tests.name: test_valid_string_operators_validate
tests.purpose: Accept a canonical string comparison operator.
tests.rationale: The contains fixture must have no validation errors; this is a focused positive semantic validation case distinct from runtime matching tests.

tests.name: test_between_with_nonzero_tolerance_fails_validation
tests.purpose: Forbid nonzero tolerance on range comparisons.
tests.rationale: The between list fixture checks BETWEEN_TOLERANCE_FORBIDDEN; covers the range-specific diagnostic produced by the shared between/not_between branch.

tests.name: test_nonzero_tolerance_is_rejected_when_runtime_would_ignore_it
tests.purpose: Forbid tolerance on operators that do not implement it.
tests.rationale: Parametrizes like, contains, starts_with and is_null; requires TOLERANCE_OPERATOR_FORBIDDEN and constructs right operands only for binary cases. Distinct from the range-specific diagnostic.

tests.name: test_duplicate_condition_ids_fail_validation
tests.purpose: Reject duplicate condition IDs within a ruleset.
tests.rationale: Two different conditions deliberately share a condition_id; requires CONDITION_ID_DUPLICATE. Keeps identity validation independent of generated compiler IDs.

tests.name: test_duplicate_condition_group_ids_fail_validation
tests.purpose: Reject duplicate group IDs across nested condition groups.
tests.rationale: A root and nested group share their explicit identity; requires CONDITION_GROUP_ID_DUPLICATE, exercising recursive rather than sibling-only collection.

tests.name: test_duplicate_assignment_target_within_rule_fails_validation
tests.purpose: Reject assigning one target twice inside a rule and identify both assignments.
tests.rationale: An explicit assignment list creates duplicate target bucket and compares the exact details map containing rule, target and both assignment IDs.

tests.name: test_duplicate_assignment_id_across_rules_fails_validation
tests.purpose: Enforce assignment ID uniqueness across rules of a single version.
tests.rationale: Two rules share assignment ID but target different fields; locates ASSIGNMENT_ID_DUPLICATE and checks ruleset/version and both rule IDs. Not redundant with duplicate target checks.

tests.name: test_duplicate_assignment_id_within_rule_has_clear_location
tests.purpose: Describe same-rule duplicate assignment IDs accurately.
tests.rationale: Two assignments to different targets share an ID inside r1; asserts the message says more than once in rule r1. This deliberately covers a diagnostic branch absent from the cross-rule test.

tests.name: test_assignment_id_may_be_reused_when_versions_are_validated_independently
tests.purpose: Allow stable assignment IDs to recur across separately validated versions.
tests.rationale: Validates two versions with the same ID but constructs a fresh validator for each. It would not detect state leaked between calls on a reused validator; retain and use one validator instance.
